_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Request for Approval of Identification Plate Drawings
summary: Requests approval of identification plate format drawings for electronic aeronautical and support equipment as required by MIL-DTL-18307(AS).
use_relationship:
The purpose of this request is to obtain approval of the identification plate format drawings when requesting Approval of Identification Plate Drawings.

This DID contains instructions applicable when requesting Approval of Identification Plate Drawings required by 3.5.7 of MIL-DTL-18307(AS).

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract SOW.

This DID is applicable to the acquisition of electronic aeronautical and support equipment.  When applied in contract, this DID will be tailored to the specific information required in Block 16 of the DD Form 1423, Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL).

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81655.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the document cited herein, including their approval dates and date of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the solicitation or contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Request for Approval of Identification Plate Drawings for electronic aeronautical and support equipment shall be in accordance with 3.5.7 of MIL-DTL-18307(AS) or as specified in the contract.
